verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a GitHub-hosted skills library that runs locally inside the user's own agent harness, with no vendor-hosted service involved. It can be installed directly from a git clone (Hermes) or through each harness's own install mechanism. The repo's `skills/` directory is the shared source of truth, and a porting guide explains how to add any new IDE, CLI or agent runner, so users fully control where and how it runs. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license or self-hosting statement in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of running it fully under your own control, and clarity on dependence on third-party harnesses and model providers.
